metadata.units: TWh/year, GW, litres diesel-equivalent/year, vehicles and kilometres
metadata.important: Not a complete calculator-ready series. Null required-energy totals are intentional. Source observations retained without fabricated history.

definitions.residentialHeat: Residential coal + peat + petroleum + natural gas final consumption; excludes electricity, renewable fuels and ambient heat. Proxy for fossil heat, not end-use measurement.
definitions.commercialPublicHeat: Commercial/public coal + peat + petroleum + natural gas final consumption.
definitions.industryHeat: Industry coal + peat + petroleum + natural gas + non-renewable waste final consumption; fuel-use proxy, includes some non-heating uses.
definitions.railDiesel: Diesel-equivalent volume derived from fossil rail diesel energy with calculator conversion; not measured litres. Biofuel and rail electricity excluded.
definitions.shippingDiesel: Diesel-equivalent volume for domestic navigation petroleum use; excludes international marine bunkers and fisheries.
definitions.electricity: SEAI electricity fuel mix supplied through EirGrid workbook; net exported generation, pumped hydro excluded; domestic renewable generation does not assign a clean share to imports.
definitions.tractorsAndMachinery: Broad CSO category, not agricultural tractors alone; mileage flagged unreliable by CSO.
definitions.goodsByUnladenWeight: Unladen weight bands, NOT gross-weight LGV/HGV classes. Requires an explicit mapping before use.

2025.status: incomplete: 2025 interim energy balance; mileage unavailable
